Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.skin

Schnittstelle SkinSource

Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
SkinSource.ByName, SkinSource.ByTexture, SkinSource.ByUniqueId
public sealed interface SkinSource permits SkinSource.ByName, SkinSource.ByUniqueId, SkinSource.ByTexture
A description of where a skin should come from, before it has been fetched.

Kept separate from NpcSkin because the two answer different questions. This type says "the skin of the player Notch", which is stable, human-readable and safe to write into a configuration file. NpcSkin holds the several hundred bytes of base64 that resolving that request produced, which is what actually goes on the wire.

Both are persisted: the source so that /npc reload can re-resolve a skin whose owner has since changed it, the resolved value so that a restart does not have to reach Mojang at all.

This interface is sealed. Extensions that fetch skins from elsewhere register a SkinProvider rather than adding a source type — the set of ways to name a skin is small and fixed, while the set of places to fetch one from is not.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • value

      String value()
      Returns the single value that identifies this source, for storage and for display.

      Together with kind() this round-trips through of(Kind, String).

      Gibt zurück:
      the player name, the unique id, or the texture value

    • requiresLookup

      boolean requiresLookup()
      Returns whether resolving this source may need a network call.

      Callers on the main thread use this to decide whether they can resolve inline or must go through SkinService.resolve(SkinSource) and continue asynchronously.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if resolution may block

    • playerName

      static SkinSource playerName(String name)
      Returns a source naming a player by their current name.

      Names are not stable — a player may change theirs, and another player may take the old one. A source built this way therefore resolves to whoever holds the name at the time it is fetched. Use uniqueId(UUID) when the identity has to stay fixed.

      Parameter:
      name - the player name
      Gibt zurück:
      the source
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if name is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is blank or longer than 16 characters

    • of

      static SkinSource of(SkinSource.Kind kind, String value)
      Rebuilds a source from its serialised form.

      The texture kind is not supported here, because a texture needs both a value and a signature and therefore does not fit in a single string. Deserialise those with texture(NpcSkin).

      Parameter:
      kind - the kind, from kind()
      value - the value, from value()
      Gibt zurück:
      the source
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if either argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if kind is SkinSource.Kind.TEXTURE, or value is not valid for kind
